importantNote: Fixed touch/click gesture responsiveness by setting explicit display:none on backdrop overlay, restored full account profile view and mobile bottom dock.

items: Fixed full-screen tap/click blocking caused by transparent fixed backdrop layer by adding explicit `display: none !important` when inactive.
Restored 100% immediate touch responsiveness for bottom navigation dock, song cards, topbar menu, and player controls.
Enabled automatic Firebase Cloud data synchronization for Favorites and Playlists on user authentication.
Added real-time listeners for `favoritesSynced` and `playlistsSynced` to render stored user data on app open.
Restored complete Account Profile page rendering (`renderProfile`).
View active user avatar, Firebase account status, and quick stats (Liked Songs, Playlists, History).
Update account password directly from profile and manage session logouts.
Enabled top-left hamburger menu button to toggle smooth slide-out sidebar drawer on mobile.
Full access to working features: Home, Search, Playlists, Favorites, Connect, Vibe AI, Profile, Settings, and Logout.
